curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can one determined man take down an army of ferocious beasts and reach the mastermind pulling their strings?
curatedMovie.description: After savage animal-warriors known as the Krugs kill his son and abduct his wife, a man named Farmer embarks on a relentless rescue quest across a kingdom threatened by the villainous Gallian.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting fantasy adventure with steady quest momentum, moderate emotional stakes, and ideal energy for group viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Uwe Boll, this adventure delivers a direct fantasy crusade packed with animal-warrior skirmishes and classic rescue-and-revenge stakes.

facts.title: In the Name of the King: A Dungeon Siege Tale
